Home Scrap Gold Buyer

What Counts as Scrap Gold — and How We Evaluate It

Scrap gold is any gold that is no longer wearable or saleable as a finished piece: fragments, findings, damaged items, dental gold, and the small leftovers from jewellery making and repair. Its value is purely its metal content — which is exactly why scrap gold evaluation must be measurement, not opinion. Mixed scrap is the hardest to judge by eye: a bag of bits can contain 22K, 18K and lower-karat soldered pieces side by side.

Our process handles that honestly. Pieces are grouped, XRF-tested so you can see the purity readings on screen, and weighed in front of you. The payout follows the same formula as everything else we buy — pure-gold weight × the day's live market rate — with the readings and weights shown to you before you decide. If some items test as low-purity or plated, we tell you plainly and you can take them back; testing is free.

If you searched for a 'scrap gold buyer near me' in Greater Noida West, Noida or Crossing Republik, our Gaur City Centre counter is a short drive away, and scrap is welcome in any quantity — a single broken earring back or a full workshop packet. For larger workshop quantities, calling ahead on +91 99532 11815 helps us keep time aside for batch testing.

How It Works

From Testing to Payment in 10–15 Minutes

1

Walk Into Our Store

Visit us at Shop No. GF-04, Gaur City Centre, Gaur Chowk, Sector 4, Greater Noida West with your jewellery and one valid photo ID (Aadhaar, Voter ID, Passport or Driving Licence).

2

Free XRF Testing

Your gold's purity is tested live on a German XRF Karatmeter. The result appears on screen in front of you — 100% transparent, zero damage.

3

Clear Valuation

We weigh your item in front of you and calculate the value from the live market rate and tested purity. Every number is explained — no hidden deductions.

4

Instant Payment

Accept the offer and get paid immediately by cash, NEFT or RTGS, with a proper invoice. The full process takes about 10–15 minutes.
